Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows two distinct pulmonary nodules (indicated by arrows) that appear larger than 5 mm; one is located in the right middle lobe region and the other in a retrocardiac position. In the context of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH), nodules larger than 5 mm are classified as carcinoid tumors, whereas smaller ones are tumorlets.
